invariants: Davison time is the arithmetic midpoint of two explicit TT birth instants.
Davison location is a spherical geographic midpoint, including dateline-safe behavior.
Planetary states are freshly evaluated at the midpoint TT by the supplied versioned ephemeris; natal longitudes are never averaged.
Requested bodies are unique and every returned state must match the requested midpoint TT and ephemeris provenance.
Antipodal location pairs fail closed because their spherical midpoint is undefined.
Houses/angles are not fabricated until a separately verified UT/sidereal-time house pipeline consumes the midpoint location.
